{{Quote|Silver Fyre helms the biggest gang of star pirates and mercenaries in the business!|Han Solo|<ref name="TG" />}}
The '''Aquaris Freeholders''' were one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] largest [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] groups during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Freeholders were based on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]], where they operated out of a large underwater base. The Freeholders were led by [[Human/Legends|Human]] criminal [[Silver Fyre/Legends|Silver Fyre]], who decided to throw her support behind the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as the war reached its height.

==Description==
{{Quote|Rather elaborate base for mercenaries and space pirates.|Leia Organa|<ref name="TG" />}}
A large gang of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], the Aquaris Freeholders were founded by notorious criminal [[Silver Fyre/Legends|Silver Fyre]], who served as the group's leader. The Freeholders consisted of a number of different [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]], [[Kraaken]], served as Fyre's right-hand man.<ref name="TG" /> After settling on the planet [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]], the Freeholders centralized their operations around a cutting-edge underwater base, which could evade topside [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] while still accomodating visiting ships with a retractable landing pad. Freeholders primarily used [[aqua-skimmer]]s for transportation through the Aquaris waves, and quickly had to become adept at using the weapons mounted on these vehicles, as their base became a frequent target of the planet's larger predators.<ref name="egpm">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Silver Fyre's Freeholders are joining us, Leia?"<br />"Having caught the traitor among our new allies... it's safe to use their help with the situation at Yavin Base, Han.|Han Solo and Leia Organa|<ref name="TG" />}}
The gang known as the Freeholders was founded by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] rogue Silver Fyre, and by the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Fyre had built her Freeholders into one of the biggest and most formidable smuggling and pirate gangs in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In their early days, the Freeholders made robbery targets of other smugglers transporting [[Spice/Legends|spice]]&mdash;one such victim was the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="TG" /> Fyre's operation eventually grew to the point where she began searching for a permanent base, an out-of-the-way [[Planet/Legends|world]] they could take over&mdash;although she considered options such as [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] and the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]], she ultimately settled on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-covered<ref name="egpm" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> planet of Aquaris.<ref name="egpm" />

As the war reached its height, Fyre began to develop [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathies, and pledged her support and the support of the Freeholders to the Alliance. Not long after, Rebel leaders [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and Fyre's old smuggling rival Solo personally visited the Freeholder base on Aquaris&mdash;however, Fyre was unaware that her right-hand man, Kraaken, was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] asset. Kraaken plotted to eliminate the Rebels and steal their [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], to deliver to the Empire important information that was purportedly stored on them. Fyre and the Rebels uncovered Kraaken's plan and foiled it together, reaffirming the Rebels' previously-shaky trust for the Freeholders. Afterward, Fyre threw the full weight of her organization behind the Rebel war effort, committing fighters to help break the Imperial [[Yavin blockade|blockade]] of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="TG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aquaris Freeholders appeared in ''[[Traitor's Gambit]]'', a [[Star Wars (comic strip)|comic strip]] story arc written by [[Archie Goodwin]], illustrated by [[Al Williamson]] and released in [[1982]].<ref name="TG" />
